about: Golden cases for register records (server-spec/register-records.md, checks RR1 to RR4). RR1: validate gives the stated refusals. RR2: upgrade gives the stated record. RR3: fold gives the stated state and verdict. RR4: represent gives the stated labels, Status, closed and fields. --record-cmd reads one case with an added 'op' (validate, upgrade or fold) and answers {refused}, {record} or {state, shown}.
